critical_findings.title: Missing Dashboard-Reports Bidirectional Links
critical_findings.description: Dashboard and Reports pages don't have hardcoded links to each other. Both rely on dynamic sidebars.
critical_findings.impact: Users can't navigate between key pages if JavaScript fails. SEO impact.

critical_findings.title: 25 Pages Rely Entirely on Dynamic Navigation
critical_findings.description: These pages have empty navigation placeholders populated only by JavaScript.
critical_findings.impact: No navigation fallback if JavaScript fails. Accessibility concerns.
